judged evaluation cases.relevance judging basis: A retrieval unit must explain which data identify the originating record, the originating record version, and the exact location of the supporting passage.

relevance judgments.rationale: F-B states that a proposal-run receipt records the source and version of the model used for a concept proposal and explicitly does not locate the evidence passage, so it does not explain which data identify the originating record, its version, and the exact location of the supporting passage.

judged evaluation cases.relevance judging basis: A retrieval unit must explain which data identify the originating record, the originating record version, and the exact location of the supporting passage.

relevance judgments.rationale: F-B mentions a source and version, but of the model that produced the proposal, not of the originating record; it does not locate the evidence passage, so it fails the declared relevance judging basis.
